items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Mary Bruni; the mention is made solely by the interviewer identifying her in a photo caption.

ctx.x: You got this bunch together. Yeah. Oh.

New Orleans jazz babies, huh? Uh-huh. This is marked 1919, the New Orleans jazz babies. Yeah. And it says, Henry Bruni's trombone, Mary Bruni's trumpet. And yourself, of course, I don't know. Sax and clarinet. When did you take up sax, anyhow?
Well, as soon as sax came on the market. See, in those days, they didn't have sax. They didn't have the system in sax.
